description: Sub-5ms latency, zero waste extraction. Best for batch list extraction, table parsing, targeted data mining. Prefer this over browser_map for pure data extraction. Note: XPath selectors lack shadow-DOM support; use CSS selectors for shadow DOMs.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

multiple.description: Whether to extract multiple elements (default true).

query.description: CSS Selector or XPath query to extract.

name: browser_scrape
